How do they turn thousands of tonnes of basmati rice into millions of microwaveable meals? How do they craft beautiful mechanical singing birds.
Drew and Al buy from sellers who share their love for country house antiques. They snap up an 18th-century chest of drawers and smokers' bow chairs.
Drew Pritchard and Viki Knott travel across the country, visiting incredible collectors who have collections of unusual, rare and historic treasures.
BMW 2002 Touring & Volvo 850R. Drew and Paul look at a Volvo 850R station wagon, the car that became an instant classic when it appeared in the 1994 British Touring Car Championship.
Find out how manhole covers, range hoods, artificial logs and snowmobiles are made, as more items are put under the microscope.

Teleshopping.
Paper conservator Ashleigh is tasked with restoring a 1967 James Bond movie poster. And, Drew asks metal worker Ted to revamp a peculiar hardwood globe.
Drew Pritchard dives in at the enormous former Naval Royal Hospital School in Suffolk and he's taught a few lessons whilst trying to negotiate a deal.
Salvage supremo Drew Pritchard is spoiled for choice at a dealership in Henley. He meets a good match in Marlborough, and tries to score a win against the house at a bingo hall.
The Victoria Diggers' desperately fight for survival, but they may have stumbled across a monster nugget. The Gold Gypsies fend off deadly snakes during their search.
The Gold Gypsies hunt for nuggets in ancient mine shafts and Greg discovers a rare meteorite. The Mahoneys chase for more gold using Ted's granddad's treasure map.
Boulder Boys Aaron and Ron almost lose their $60,000 excavator on unstable ground. Off-the-grid opal hunting family The McFarlanes race a storm in Lightning Ridge.
Desperate for a find, the Bushmen gamble on a dangerous mining method deep below ground. In Lightning Ridge an injury causes The Bros a serious setback.
In the Cotswolds, Drew looks around an impressive manor house. Then, he visits a converted chapel in Burnley filled with incredible antiques and a car show room in Jersey.
Henry and Fuzz travel to Wokingham to meet Pete, who's been hanging onto an Austin A40. After decades off the road, it is in desperate need of rescue.
Henry and Fuzz explore Roger's garage of buses in Coventry. For former mechanic Fuzz, it's a busman's holiday, for Henry, it's a voyage of discovery.
Henry and Fuzz meet a lifelong biker with unique motorbikes. Fuzz discovers a 1950s step through scooter, but Henry prefers low-capacity sports bikes.

pr.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
pr.d: The boys are on Henry's home turf in Oxfordshire to visit another upcycler. In her collection they find an Anglepoise lamp, a chest of drawers, a portable stove and a sack trolley.
Angus finds unique Coronation Street memorabilia in Amanda Barrie's Georgian home. Plus, he helps a former Blue Peter presenter at his farm in Wales.
Hong Kong To A Galaxy Far Away. Shaun asks Angus to clear his late father's home. It's packed with unusual items from East Asia, but some forgotten toys are the stars at auction.
Tahmina Ghaffar and David Harper fish for antiques around the fens. They unearth a Ching dynasty wedding basket and a Scandinavian lamp.
Brothers sell their late mum's furniture. And a couple are overwhelmed by inherited heirlooms. But will a former lover's engagement ring sell.
Car Boot Find Makes A Fortune. From a wheeler-dealer's hoard to mint condition gold, Irita digs for profits big enough to spoil 33 grandkids and book a luxury cruise.
A beloved banjo gets a new lease of life. Leather expert Suzie revives a pair of 1930s rollerskates and an antique wooden salad bowl is ready to serve again.
How do they make an almost invisible hearing aid that connects wirelessly to a phone? How do they build the carriages for London's new underground railway.
How do they build remote-controlled underwater robots to do jobs too dangerous for human divers? How do they make the world's most cuddly teddy bears.
When a Mother's Day killing horrifies a town, investigators must understand what motivates a monster to predict the killer's next move.
A detective discovers that he knows a kidnapper personally and that getting the victim back alive now hinges on his relationship with a maniac.
When the Cravens bring in handyman Rusty McIntire to remodel their basement, it sets off a chain of events that razes their marriage to the ground.
Ron Hiiri is a ladies' man living the good life in upscale Connecticut. But a new girlfriend and a stock market crash send his life out of control.
A feud between a man and his stepfather boils over when they fight over the family home. A night of violence finally tears the family apart for good.
Two men start an auto body repair business, but a bitter feud erupts, and one man goes missing with indisputable evidence of a brutal murder.

It is a very cold winter day. Peppa and George are wearing their hats, scarves, mittens and coats. They want to jump in muddy puddles, but the puddles are all frozen and slippery.
George has fun looking at himself in the mirror and tries to find other shiny things.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never, ever wants to take them off - until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her chickens, whilst something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse. Grampy Rabbit knows all about the sea, and can make a lot of noise too, which is useful.
It is raining outside so Peppa and George have to stay indoors. While they wait for the rain to stop, Daddy Pig teaches them a fun game.
It's all play and not much work when Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office.
Peppa and her friends are going camping. Madame Gazelle, their teacher, is in charge. First they put up their tents. Then they collect sticks to make a campfire.
Gerald Giraffe is new to playgroup! He's trying to make friends with Peppa and the group, but finds being so tall is making playing hide and seek quite a challenge.
Mummy and Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have a wonderful day with Mr. Potato at Digger World.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa doesn't like spiders and screams very loudly. But soon she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her.
Peppa's French friend Delphine Donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work - as well as Happy Mrs Chicken. But who will fix it when it breaks.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit takes the children for swimming lessons in the little children's pool. At the end of the lesson, giant inflatables are brought out including an inflatable slide.
Today is the grown-ups' singing competition at the theatre and the kids are the judges. The children jump up and down and sing along. Everybody loves singing.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first.
Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed.
Madame Gazelle gets the playgroup to play music - with instruments that they must make themselves.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies.
Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.
Grampy Rabbit's new jet pack shoots off into the distance and he ends up on top of a snowy mountain.
Peppa and her friends learn about climbing from Grampy Rabbit at the climbing centre. Mummy Pig is worried about George when he gets scared of heights.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day.
Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.
Grandpa Pig has created a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The Police hear their signal and are surprised.
Mummy Pig joins with the other mummies to practise fighting fires at the fire station. The fire brigade demonstrate their practice using their motto.
For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.
A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.
At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake.
Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.
Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
Daddy Pig teaches Peppa to ride her bicycle without stabilisers - just like her friends.
It is a rainy day but Peppa doesn't mind - her garden is full of lovely, muddy puddles.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel have come to teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Peppa and family go on an exciting trip to Paris to see the sights and meet Delphine Donkey and her family.
Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to visit a house that Mr Bull is building. Who will their new neighbours be.
Peppa and George have an exciting day rescuing their friends in Granddad Dog's breakdown truck.
Peppa and her family go on a nature trail. They learn how to follow trails of footprints, which comes in handy when they get a bit lost..
Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's award for Industry for all the hard work she does. Peppa and her friends accompany Miss Rabbit to the Palace to meet the Queen.
Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski.
Peppa and George are having a fancy dress party, Peppa is dressed as a fairy princess and George is dressed as a scary dinosaur.
George isn't very good at hide and seek until Daddy Pig helps him to find somewhere to hide.
Peppa hears Daddy Pig making a strange sound. It's called whistling, but when Peppa tries, she discovers that it is quite impossible - at first.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any "baby" games.
George makes friends with Richard Rabbit at the playground.
Peppa and her family go for a day's cycle ride. Along the way, they meet all their friends and have a big bike race.
Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited! Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, bearing gifts.
Daddy Pig finds Peppa and Suzy an old box of garden games to play with.
Peppa's family car breaks down. While it is being mended, they borrow a shiny new one from Grandad Dog's garage.
Peppa and her family visit Windy Castle. The view from Windy Castle is fantastic - Peppa and George can even see Granny and Grandpa's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's Moon Exhibition with George's friend Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit hurts her ankle, so Mummy Rabbit takes over her job at the supermarket. Miss Rabbit has lots of other jobs, so Daddy Pig and Granddad Dog help out too.
Pedro Pony spends the day just like a real cowboy would have in the Wild West: setting up camp in the garden and sharing stories with his friends.
Wendy Wolf's birthday is here and she has invited Peppa and friends around for a party.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat for a day on the river. Daddy Pig is the captain, Peppa, George and Mummy Pig are the crew. But then the boat gets stuck.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when you say please and thank you.
While Peppa and her friends are at Playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a Lucky Hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle.
Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in an apartment above the shops. Peggi and Pandora Panda, and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when Mr. Bull arrives to do some noisy work - he is building a windmill, to make electricity! The children join in and make their own windmills too.
Mummy Pig suggests they all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then actually bump into Mrs Crocodile. Then Mr Lion invites them to a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language. Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his new hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of a muddy puddle.
Peppa and her friends are introduced to some simple woodcraft in the woods with Mr Wolf.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea, and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero-themed party and Super Potato is one of the guests.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own endings too.
Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat.
The children make good use of their clubhouse by playing an adventure game, imaginging that there are wild animals outside - even if it is just Daddy Pig.
Peppa and her friends go to school early to have breakfast together.

When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre and needs fixing, Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket. George sits in the trolley, while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list. Daddy Pig picks up something not on the list.
It's Peppa Pig's birthday today. She wakes up very early so that none of her special day is wasted. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks, and makes a birthday cake appear.
Peppa and George are going to Granny and Grandpa's for Sunday lunch, but get stuck in a traffic jam.
When Peppa meets Father Christmas at the supermarket, she invites him to her playgroup's Christmas play.
The Biggest Muddy Puddle In The World: Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
Peppa and George have one more game of jumping up and down in muddy puddles before bedtime.
Peppa and George visit Rebecca Rabbit's house today. Rebecca's house is a bit different to Peppa's house - it is inside a hill! And instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her friends play with their toy boats at the pond.
Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to see a fish pond he used to visit when he was a little piggy.
The family car is very muddy. Peppa and George have lots of fun helping Mummy and Daddy clean it.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children quickly catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill.
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it's Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.
Bull's New Road: Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building.
Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic, and Zoe Zebra has to rescue him.
Peppa and George meet their new cousin, a tiny baby piggy called Alexander.

Mummy Pig finds a spider in the house and orders Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes, wherever he likes.
Grampy Rabbit visits Peppa's playgroup to talk about space rockets.
Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson. Peppa loves dancing. Everyone loves dancing.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
George has the best birthday ever, including a visit to the Dinosaur Museum.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper, until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Peppa meets her new playschool friend Emily Elephant.
Peppa and George have fun making potato prints and painting a lovely picture of a cherry tree.
Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends.
Peppa and her friends are building a desert island, in the sandpit. They add a forest, a lake, houses, and shops. It's all going very well until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.
Peppa and George play at being pretty butterflies, wriggly worms and muddy frogs.
Peppa and George play piggy-in-the-middle. George catches the ball with a little help from Daddy Pig.
It's Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig, the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.
What's that sound? Is it a car alarm? Is it a fire engine? No, it's Baby Alexander. Babies cry a lot - but Alexander likes listening to Peppa. She knows about all sorts of things.
Peppa and George notice they have shadows, and no matter how fast they walk, run, or jump - they can't lose them.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: On a dark and stormy night, Tim's fears of a local legend and Boss Baby's fear of a PuppyCo agent make the brothers to unite to stay safe as the house is infiltrated.
Rock and Scissors notice that Paper invents better when angry in 'Paper's Secret Weapon', and then in 'The Sled Hill', after Scissors breaks his arm, he tries to hide it from Paper.
Chuck moves in after Lil & Jack accidentally destroy his house in 'Caught Rubber - Handed', then in 'And... Action!', Lily films her own K-Drama finale with her family as the cast & crew.
The family scrambles to prep for inspection in 'Just a Little Pipe Problem', then in 'Camp Chuck', Chuck's theatre camp goes haywire.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A Puppy Party reunites Boss Baby with his foe Bug the Pug.
In The Void, Shadow intercepts Sonic's latest Shatterspace transverse, for a personal face-to-fist encounter.
Phoebe's newest mission is to babysit President Kickbutt's troublemaking daughter, but things get out of hand when they sneak into an illegal nightclub.
After Cherry posts a photo revealing the Thundermans' secret, the Hero League forces Phoebe to end the relationship with her best friend.
When Henry's mom has her purse stolen, Captain Man decides he should move in with Henry's family to protect them, but Henry isn't so keen.
When Henry is caught sneaking out at night, he is grounded, keeping him from his crime-fighting duties. Piper drives him crazy at home. Charlotte becomes sidekick.
The whole city is hunting critters in 'Critter Capture Quest', then in 'Mica's New Friend', Mica and Marcel become unlikely besties.
Gargamel, Queen of the Prom: When the Smurf Girls invite all the Smurfs to their Grand Equinox Ball, Gargamel and Azrael crash the party. (S2, ep 24b).
Scaredy discovers the forest in 'The Tour', and then in 'Smurfing a Masterpiece', Baby Smurf is the new Painter.
Leaf's Under the Weather: When Leaf gets sick, the weather in the Smurf Village starts to go wild. (S2, ep 25a).
Lily and Farmer have to save the village from a slobbering monster in 'Monster in the Village', then in 'Granny's Doll', Rowena is turned into Smurfette and takes her place in the village.
Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much in 'Alvin Management', then in 'Time Capsule', the school digs up an old high school time capsule, and Miss Smith and Dave keep an old secret.
The Chipmunks and Chipettes play in a dodgeball tournament in 'Munk Vs Machine', then in 'Shack Magic', The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but is it magic.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: : Convinced old people are the new enemy, Boss Baby uses Tim to create havoc at the senior center, but a war soon begins when the seniors rally against babies.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: U.: Boss Baby must "de-stink" Simmons after a misfire of Stinkless Serum, and Tim & Danny try to upgrade their smallscale taxi business.
Rock struggles to keep a secret from Paper in 'The Secret', then in 'Sandpaper's Workout Program', Sandpaper makes the guys work out.
Patrick defends the house from burglars in 'Pat Alone...At Home', then in 'Seagull Scout Adventures', Patrick must earn a badge.
SpongeBob loses his beloved underwear in 'My Tighty Whiteys', then in 'What Ever Happened to Baby Prunes?', Baby Prunes shares her child star past.
Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol in 'Art For Art's Sake', and then in 'Mancave', Alvin, convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in, tries to stop it.
Sam and Kit track a legendary creature in 'The Legend of the Night Howler', then in 'The Haystack Stakeout', who would steal a cute forest pika's dry flower pile.
Stan has a fake Marsupilami robot in 'Stan's Showtime', then in 'The Truth Is Out There', Acu and Mica seek a fish thief.
When things start to mysteriously disappear around the dollhouse, Gabby and Pandy play detectives.
It's Smurfies versus Gargamel in 'See Gargamel Run', then in 'Hefty Baby', Baby Smurf gets stronger.
The Road Warrior / My Fair Chipette: More adventures with the pint-sized chipmunks. And Alvin, who is also a chipmunk, and therefore of broadly similar size.
Alvin and Brittany are convinced Simon has vanished back in time in'Time Flies', and in 'Prank Calls', a prank call by Alvin gets out of hand when someone vows to track him down.
Someone from Scissors' past returns in 'Scissors' Catapult', and then in 'Pencil and Potato', Pencil gets lost in the mountains and tries to find a way home with the un-help of Potato.
Scissors tries to fit a year into 12 hours in 'Resolutions', and then in 'Paper's Book Club', Paper puts together a smart book club with the least intelligent people he knows.
LAD has a sleepover and Jack makes a promise in 'J-LAD', then in 'Big Honey', when Will's parents visit Canyon Valley, news of the sale of their bee farm sends the family into a spiral.
Grim: Sonic learns that Nine is using the New Yoke shard to create his dream world in a barren shatterspace called The Grim. Can Sonic convince Nine to fight with him.
The Chipettes set out to prove that being a superhero isn't just a guy thing in 'Super Girls', then in 'Held Back', Alvin must pass his next test, or be separated from his brothers.
The Chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory in 'Mutiny', then in 'Reality or Not', Alvin is tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by Reality TV stars.

Goomer's mom is coming to visit, but has no idea that her son is an MMA fighter. Dice needs help to convince Goomer's mom that Goomer is really a teacher.

When Captain Man loses his powers of invulnerability, he becomes too afraid to fight crime. It is up to Kid Danger to keep Swellview safe.
When a suspicious new student shows up at school, Charlotte and Henry think he may be up to something. Captain Man goes undercover as a substitute teacher.

A further selection of creepy-crawly close-ups, focusing on courtship in the bug world. Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough.

A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself.

Initially, suspicion falls on a stalker, but the plot thickens further with the discovery that Debbie was pregnant at the time of her murder. Trevor Eve, Sue Johnston, Holly Aird and Tessa Peake-Jones star.

A black man is murdered in a jail cell by a confirmed racist - a crime the prison service blames on overcrowding. With Donald Sinden and Jenny Seagrove.

Crime drama, starring Emilia Fox, Tara Fitzgerald, Issy Knopfler and Jamie Bamber.

The squad investigates a long-running feud between two family ice-cream businesses, which resulted in a shooting and several armed raids 10 years ago. With Dennis Waterman and Amanda Redman, alongside guest star Jodie Kelly.
